After the words किम् and इदम् , घ (इय्) is substituted for the व् of वतुप्‌।

Terms: किम् and इदम्

The affixes डति (अति with the elision of इम्) and वतुप्‌ come in the sense of 'numerical quantity' after the word किम् in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: डति and वतुप्‌

The affix अत् (अ) comes after किम् ending in the Locative -7th case.

Terms: अत् (अ)- किम्

Also after किम् comes the affix थमु in the sense of denoting a manner.

Terms: थमु
To the affixes तर and तम (घ -- तरप्तमपौ घः
) ordained to come after the word किम् -- अतिशायने तमबिष्ठनौ
, or after a word ending in ए -- घकालतनेषु कालनाम्नः
, or after a finite verb -- तिङश्च

, or after an indeclinable, is added the affix आम् , but not if the excess belongs to a substance (and not to an action or quality)

Terms: तर and तम

The समासान्त affix is not applied to a word preceded by किम् in the sense of reproach.

Terms: समासान्त

क is substituted for किम् before a विभक्ति affix.

Terms: सर्वनाम

Also after a form of किम् when the particle चित् follows it and when no other word precedes such form of किम् the finite verb retains its accent.

Terms: Accent
